setup.install: Open the official Google Meet origin in a supported browser, confirm the intended browser profile, and offer its browser-provided progressive web app installation only when a standalone launcher is requested.
setup.preserve: Preserve existing browser profiles, Meet site data, account sessions, camera and microphone choices, notification decisions, installed web app identity, shortcuts, meeting history, and managed Workspace policies.
setup.safety: Do not sign into Google, join or create a meeting, grant camera, microphone, screen-sharing, or notification access, install a PWA or extension, save a meeting code, or alter browser profiles without approval.
setup.verify: Load only Meet's official landing page or approved PWA shell, verify the HTTPS origin and installed-app identity, and confirm no account session, media permission, meeting connection, extension, or notification subscription was created.
